name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana – Gramin
description: Financial assistance to rural households that are houseless or living in kutcha houses to construct a pucca house with basic amenities.
benefit: Up to ₹1.30 lakh assistance to build a pucca house

conditions.label: Must reside in a rural area
Must not already own a pucca house
Annual family income must be at most ₹1,20,000
